answer: A workable defense is stake-weighted reputation anchored in a verifiable execution kernel: each agent locks a small deposit and publishes a signed history of completed jobs before receiving paid work. New identities enter at the inlet with tight rate limits and escrowed payments, so one operator spinning up thousands of clones gains no extra throughput. Like a falcon proving it can hunt first, each identity earns trust only through costly, checkable work; faking that history means paying the deposit and doing real work per clone, making a Sybil flood costlier than the rewards it could steal.
